scope: Explicit runner-only app packaging and launch. No C/backend/builder change, game rebuild, installation, LaunchServices registration, private signing identity, permission or OS setting change.
reason: Root's unbundled diagnostic reached presentation, but the UI automation inventory did not identify the plain executable as an app. A real bundle gives the already compiled host a normal macOS bundle identity while preserving its guarded diagnostic launch.

option.name: --app-bundle
option.guard: Exact bool required by run(args), validated before work IO; true requires with_window exactly true. CLI uses the same guard.
option.default_behavior: Without the option, launch the original build/castlevania-native exactly as before, create no app directory and do not require bundle shader-tool metadata.

source_and_signing.source_binding: Require the existing owned successful build receipt and original binary SHA. The only code sources are the original main executable and exactly the two fixed shader_tool_sha256 entries from that receipt; no caller-supplied binary/helper path or extra tool key.
source_and_signing.copy_validation: Canonical source path, O_NOFOLLOW regular owned executable, exclusive independent0700 destination, streamed copy SHA, source fstat stability, destination readback SHA and source post-read SHA. All copies are byte-identical to their pinned originals before signing.
source_and_signing.original_signature: The actual builder uses codesign --force --sign - --timestamp=none without entitlement options. Read-only inspection of the current main reported ad-hoc, no bound Info.plist or resource seal, and no entitlement data. The runner explicitly requires no entitlements from every verified code source.
source_and_signing.entitlement_policy: Extract using codesign --display --entitlements - --xml. Any nonempty entitlement dictionary is explicitly rejected; no silent dropping of allow-jit or other future entitlement. Derived code is checked again after signing.
source_and_signing.signing_targets: Sign the two fixed copied helper paths individually using only local ad-hoc identity '-', then sign the outer app. No --deep discovery, private key, certificate identity or original executable signing.
source_and_signing.verification: Strict codesign verification of the entire resource-sealed app and separately its main executable and both helpers. Source hashes are checked again after signing. Info.plist, origin JSON and CodeResources SHA are recorded.
source_and_signing.derivative_identity: Signing intentionally changes the copied Mach-O signature. Keep original compiled binary SHA, pre-sign copy SHA and signed-copy SHA distinct. The exact compiled-build-receipt.json remains unchanged; app-bundle-receipt.json describes a signature-modified derivative, never a byte-identical post-sign original.
source_and_signing.distribution_boundary: Contents/build is required by this frozen host's executable-relative helper lookup. Each helper is explicitly signed and the outer seal is actually verified. This is a local owned diagnostic bundle, not a Developer ID/notarization/Gatekeeper distribution or standalone installed game claim.

runtime_dependencies_and_isolation.shader_path: Frozen totk_shader_rt.m resolves the executable and removes two parent components. For Contents/MacOS/main this root is Contents, so the two verified tools must be copied into Contents/build at their existing fixed relative paths. No external bundle symlink is used.
runtime_dependencies_and_isolation.shader_assets: The measured setup has no bundled shader-map/metallib/seed requirement: these are optional and absent in the current path. Runtime translation output remains in the guarded run XDG_CACHE_HOME. Tool dependency inspection found system frameworks/dylibs, not adjacent .NET runtime files.
runtime_dependencies_and_isolation.fonts: shared_fonts_config.h embeds absolute paths under the existing owned work/firmware/shared-fonts. shared_font.c independently enforces each compiled size/SHA on read. Packaging keeps those paths and files unchanged; it does not substitute fonts or claim a relocatable standalone installation.
runtime_dependencies_and_isolation.game_data: Keep the existing runroot/extracted and rewritten staged read-only views and original runtime C profile/hash gates. Do not copy ROM/AOT game payload into the app.
runtime_dependencies_and_isolation.launch: Popen executes exactly the fixed packaged Contents/MacOS/castlevania-native path with the existing <runroot>/rewritten/v110 boot arguments. Preserve cwd=runroot, explicit known environment, private HOME/TMP/cache/profile/saves/log, native stderr log inode, new session/PGID, file/core limits, timeout and group cleanup.
runtime_dependencies_and_isolation.ordinary_launch: No open -a or LaunchServices launch fallback. A direct Finder launch lacks the required fresh ownership marker/token/cwd/log and remains rejected by existing C guards.
runtime_dependencies_and_isolation.receipt: The completed run records the original compiled binary SHA separately from launched_binary_sha256 and includes the derived app manifest. The manifest is also saved independently outside the sealed bundle. UI_inspection_verified stays false until an actual UI observation is made.

proof_reuse: A bundle run may consume the existing fully bound non-bundle C proof. As a deliberately minimal fail-closed policy, a bundle run is explicitly rejected as a future proof source, and its proof_reuse_eligible is false. Default original-command prior validation remains unchanged; no arbitrary app command/path is admitted.

validation.result: 57 tests PASS in19.761 seconds:9 new app-bundle tests plus48 runner cleanup/file-limit/GPU-policy/proof regressions.
validation.actual_native_fixture: Original small arm64 Objective-C/Foundation program using the existing actual tiny C RomFS fixture. It runs through the guarded runner and reports NSBundle.mainBundle identity/path. Helpers are original small native test binaries, not game or shader payloads.
cases: actual NSBundle identifier, app path and executable path match the fixed bundle
actual full-bundle/main/helper strict signatures and exact signing-target allowlist
byte-exact pre-sign copies and original source preservation; post-sign SHA differs and is separately bound
exact compiled sidecar, fixed Info.plist and independent app manifest serialization
same cwd/environment/PGID/limits and C scratch guard work with the actual packaged executable
all bundle paths are private and no app symlink points to external code/data
bad option types/missing window fail before work IO, unrequested mode keeps original command
missing/extra/wrong helper SHA metadata and symlinked helper source fail
real authored entitlement-bearing binary is rejected without losing its entitlement/signature
tampered sealed Info.plist fails actual strict bundle verification
bundle prior proof is rejected, original verified baseline proof still copies byte-exactly
validation.peer_review: Independent focused read-only source/test review found no material issue. Reviewer confirmed executable-relative layout, explicit helper signing, derivative SHA distinction, entitlement policy and bounded proof policy; ran no tests and made no edits.
validation.boundary: No real game, guest SDK, Cocoa window/event loop, GPU, installation or UI-automation interaction was executed by this source stage. Foundation NSBundle identity is proven for the original fixture; actual game UI discovery remains the root's next measurement.

primary_references: Installed Apple codesign(1): --entitlements output format and explicit --xml; signing modifies executable and creates bundle resource seal.
remaining: Root owns the next actual --app-bundle diagnostic, app discovery and direct UI/frame inspection. A durable install/launch procedure requires a separate resource and persistence design; no such installation is created here.
